text_block_list.text:
At Rice Shower's earnest request, we came 
to pray at the shrine together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for granting Rice's wish today, 
Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for granting Rice's wish today, 
Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that I'd like to go out 
somewhere with you sometime, Big 
Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking that I'd like to go out 
somewhere with you sometime, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... I didn't want Big Brother to get 
caught up in Rice's bad luck...
choice_data_list: And that's why you're praying with me...?

And that's why we're praying for divine 
intervention...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So... I didn't want Big Sister to get 
caught up in Rice's bad luck...
choice_data_list: And that's why you're praying with me...?

And that's why we're praying for divine 
intervention...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah…… I just thought that maybe God 
would listen to my wish if I were with 
you, Big Brother……

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... I thought maybe if I'm with you, 
Big Sister, God might grant my wish...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, will you come visit the shrine with 
Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Thank you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Thank you, Big Sister!

And so, when the two of them prayed 
together—
(Craaash)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kyaah...!?

It seemed a piece of the dilapidated roof 
had fallen down...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ugh, Rice really is...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... I'm sure that if Rice hadn't been 
here, none of this would've happened...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice really is...
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Rice Shower's wish!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Rice...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-Then... this isn't misfortune... it's 
good luck?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be... God actually answered my 
wish...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It must be because you were with me, Dear 
Brother... I feel like my body has gotten 
so much lighter...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It must be because you were with me, Dear 
Sister... I feel like my body has gotten 
so much lighter...!

Whether her prayers reached the heavens or 
not, Rice Shower looked overjoyed.

It seemed a piece of the dilapidated roof 
had fallen down...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uuu... It's all Rice's fault...!

Just as I tried to chase after her, I 
tripped over a groove in the cobblestones 
and stumbled awkwardly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother...! Are you okay? I'm sorry... 
It's all Rice's fault... Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister...! Are you okay? I'm sorry... 
It's all Rice's fault... Uuu.

No matter how many times I explained that 
it wasn't her fault, she remained 
thoroughly depressed...
